label: a
rationale: All three topology batches in one head. Ascoli-Arzela, Baire/complete-metrizability, covering spaces and the general Stone-Weierstrass all lean on compactness and completeness in metric and uniform spaces, and their cross-references are exactly what a single reviewer needs to see end to end.

label: b
rationale: Complex analysis with linear algebra: power series, contour integration and Jordan form share the spectral and polynomial-algebra machinery, and neither category has enough batches to occupy an Alpha alone.

label: c
rationale: Number theory with category theory, the residual pairing. They are genuinely unrelated, but with five categories and three Alphas two singletons must share, and these two are the pair with no dependency edge between them at all.
